original_context_preserved.text: This ATP-dependent two-event bypass converts sedoheptulose7-phosphate (S7P) through sedoheptulose1, 7-bisphosphate (SBP) to erythrose4-phosphate (E4P) and glycerone phosphate (DHAP). Exact Rhea chemistry is S7P + ATP -> SBP + ADP + H(+), followed by SBP -> E4P + DHAP. Native RXN0-6541 and SEDOBISALDOL-RXN map to directional RHEA31444 and cleavage30169; native 30170 is bidirectional and 30168 is condensation. The generic S7P class is distinct from alpha-pyranose CPD-19339/CHEBI133984. PfkA is a native homotetramer and FbaA a homodimer, not the mixed PfkA/PfkB assembly suggested by the frozen PathBank component list. Reference P0A796/b3916 and P0AB71/b2925 and MG1655 GeneIDs948412/947415 anchor identity; off-taxon GeneIDs93777982/93779073 belong to Shigella sonnei and are rejected. Database taxonomic range and reference identity do not establish unmodified wild-type flux in every strain.

original_context_preserved.text: FbaA is a cytosolic class-II metal-dependent dimer. Native location/GO annotation is independent of SUBUNIT text. As-purified metal content was up to 0.3 Zn/0.2 Ni per monomer; denaturation-assisted Zn loading produced2.3 Zn per monomer and 3.8-fold higher activity. Source numbering follows removed initiating methionine: His 110/226/264 catalytic ligands and Asp144/Glu174/Glu181 secondary-site ligands; historical His 108/111 is not silently renumbered. Native Co/Fe/Mn active metalloprotein alternatives are distinct from additive metal effects. Ni inhibits, Cu2+ strongly inhibits in vitro, low Zn slightly activates/high Zn slightly inhibits, Co slightly activates, and Ca/Mg/Mn had no effect in the measured preparation. Cytoplasmic copper is mainly cuprous, limiting physiological Cu2+ claims.
